facts.text: Perseus was founded in early 2004 by Dexter Salna with a 40-employee, Toronto-based acquisition. It pursues a permanent buy-and-hold acquisition strategy, never re-selling businesses that join the group.
facts.source_title: Constellation announces the retirement of Dexter Salna | CSI Software

facts.text: Perseus is one of six operating groups within Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). The parent company Constellation Software has completed over 1,000 acquisitions since 1995.

Constellation Software's Perseus Group entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire Optimal Blue Business Division of Black Knight, Inc. for $700 million USD on July 14, 2023. The structure included $200 million in cash with the remainder financed by a $500 million USD promissory note at 7 percent interest over 40 years.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software's Perseus Group Enters into Agreement to Acquire Black Knight's Optimal Blue Business | CSI Software

facts.text: Perseus completed the acquisitions of Optimal Blue and the Empower loan origination system (LOS) from Black Knight, Inc. on September 15, 2023. Optimal Blue is the market leader in mortgage secondary marketing technology.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software's Perseus Group Completes Acquisition of Black Knight's Empower and Optimal Blue Businesses | CSI Software

facts.text: The Empower LOS acquisition price was not publicly disclosed. Market estimates suggested Empower could be valued around $400 million based on Black Knight's solicitation of buyers.
facts.source_title: Black Knight to sell Empower loan origination software business? | HousingWire

facts.item: AI strategy and Dark Matter Technology
facts.text: In 2025, the Perseus Group of Constellation Software launched Dark Matter Technology, a cutting-edge Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad, India focused on AI, machine learning, cloud computing, and cybersecurity. The center began in 2024 with 750 employees and plans to triple its workforce.
facts.source_title: Constellation Perseus Launches DarkMatter, its GCC in Hyderabad | AIM

facts.item: AI integration in vertical market software
facts.text: Constellation Software, through Perseus and its portfolio, is actively integrating artificial intelligence into its vertical market software products to enhance functionality. AI is being leveraged to reduce loan origination time and deliver insights shaped around customers' industry requirements.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software (TSX:CSU): Can AI Strengthen Its Software Edge?

facts.text: Perseus completed the acquisition of Auto-IT Pty Ltd, a market leading dealer management system for franchise automotive, agriculture, trucking and construction equipment markets, on March 4, 2024. This marked Perseus' tenth acquisition in the dealership software market.
facts.source_title: Perseus Operating Group of Constellation Software Completes Acquisition of Auto-IT Group | BusinessWire

facts.text: In April 2024, Perseus Group Software Corp. acquired Valeyo Inc. and its loan origination software (LOS) business from Securian Canada, Inc. This acquisition amplified Perseus' mortgage technology suite.
facts.source_title: Securian Canada Inc. Announces Sale of Valeyo Inc. and Its Loan Origination Software to Perseus Group Software Corp. | BusinessWire

facts.text: Perseus completed the acquisition of IronHQ, a provider of end-to-end dealership solutions for the agriculture and construction equipment dealership market, in March 2026. This was Perseus' 11th acquisition within the dealer ecosystem.
facts.source_title: Perseus Operating Group of Constellation Software Completes Acquisition of IronHQ | BusinessWire

facts.text: Perseus completed the acquisition of Starkwood Media Group in April 2026, a leading provider of website design and digital solutions for car, van, motorbike and leisure vehicle dealers across the United Kingdom.
facts.source_title: Perseus Operating Group of Constellation Software Acquires Starkwood | BusinessWire

facts.text: Dexter Salna served as the chief executive and architect of Perseus from its founding in early 2004 until his retirement effective December 31, 2023. He became Chairman of Perseus Operating Group starting 2022 and continues in that role after his retirement as CEO.
facts.source_title: Constellation announces the retirement of Dexter Salna | CSI Software

facts.text: Bonnie Wilhelm has served as Co-President of Perseus Group since 2022. She is also Chief Executive Officer of Andromeda Division and Chief Operating Officer of Perseus Operating Group. Prior to 2022, she was CFO and Vice President at Constellation HomeBuilder Systems from 2012 to 2022.
facts.source_title: Bonnie Wilhelm - Perseus Group, Constellation Software | LinkedIn

facts.text: The Perseus Group board includes Dexter Salna (Chairman), Mark Leonard (Founder and Chairman of Constellation Software), and Bernie Anzarouth (Chief Investment Officer of Constellation Software).
facts.source_title: Constellation announces the retirement of Dexter Salna | CSI Software

facts.text: Constellation Software has acknowledged that Perseus runs effective processes that are free of last-minute deal attrition, which is important to the company's acquisition model.
Perseus Group is headquartered in Markham, Ontario, Canada at 8133 Warden Ave, 7th Floor, Markham, Ontario L6G 1B3.
